description: The plot titled “Finetuning for different \(r\), Gazeta” illustrates how ROUGE-1 varies with \(\log r\) for four finetuning setups. The x-axis is labeled “\(\log r\)”, uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 9 with integer tick spacing. The y-axis is labeled “ROUGE-1”, uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 35 with ticks every 5 units. Four solid lines with circular markers are shown: the red line (T5 + LoRA) starts near 23.2 at \(\log r=0\), rises gradually to about 24.5 around \(\log r=7\), then is about 24.0 at \(\log r=9\); the blue line (MBart + LoRA) starts near 4.8 at \(\log r=0\), increases to about 8.0 at \(\log r=1\), drops to about 2.5 at \(\log r=2\), then climbs to about 19.0 at \(\log r=4\), about 22.5 at \(\log r=5\), reaches about 24.0 at \(\log r=8\), and ends near 23.2 at \(\log r=9\); the green line (T5 + AdaLoRA) starts near 23.2 at \(\log r=0\), increases through roughly 25.6 at \(\log r=3\) and about 27.0 at \(\log r=4\), reaches about 29.8 at \(\log r=7\), and ends around 30.0 at \(\log r=9\); the orange line (MBart + AdaLoRA) starts near 4.8 at \(\log r=0\), rises to about 13.3 at \(\log r=2\) and about 19.5 at \(\log r=3\), jumps to about 32.0 at \(\log r=4\), then increases slightly to about 33.3 by \(\log r=6\) and remains around 33.4 at \(\log r=9\).
